evals.description: Refines a coarse step into atomic sub-steps. Validates that sub-steps are numbered N.1, N.2, ..., N.K, parent is marked refined=true, and progress denominator counts only leaf steps.
evals.setup:
mkdir -p /tmp/eval-refine-0/.memplan && cd /tmp/eval-refine-0 && cat > .memplan/plan.mem <<'EOF'
title:implement-api-layer
step-count:#5
status:in-progress
~2026-05-28T10:00Z +step:id=1,text=design-data-model,atomic=true
~2026-05-28T10:05Z +step:id=2,text=create-database-schema,atomic=true,deps=1
~2026-05-28T10:10Z +step:id=3,text=implement-user-auth-and-middleware,atomic=false
~2026-05-28T10:15Z +step:id=4,text=add-api-docs,atomic=true,deps=3
~2026-05-28T10:20Z +step:id=5,text=write-integration-tests,atomic=true,deps=4
EOF
cat > .memplan/progress <<'EOF'
2/5 | step 2 text
EOF
cat > .memplan/deps-closure.mem <<'EOF'
plan.mem:slice.mem
progress:slice.mem
EOF
evals.expected_output: Step 3 refined into 3.1–3.K (K sub-steps, where K is between 2 and 5). Progress denominator updated from 5 to 5+K-1 (original 5 steps minus the refined parent plus K sub-steps). Sub-steps are marked atomic=true. Parent step 3 is marked refined=true. Sub-steps have correct dependencies inferred.

assertions.text: plan.mem contains sub-steps with ids 3.1, 3.2, etc., all marked atomic=true
progress file shows denominator equal to number of leaf steps (non-refined steps)
stale.mem contains entries marking dependents of plan.mem as stale

evals.description: Refines the current step (from progress file). Validates idempotent behavior when step is already refined unless force=true.
evals.setup:
mkdir -p /tmp/eval-refine-1/.memplan && cd /tmp/eval-refine-1 && cat > .memplan/plan.mem <<'EOF'
title:build-frontend
step-count:#4
status:in-progress
~2026-05-28T11:00Z +step:id=1,text=create-react-components,atomic=false
~2026-05-28T11:05Z +step:id=2,text=add-routing,atomic=true,deps=1
~2026-05-28T11:10Z +step:id=3,text=style-with-css,atomic=true,deps=1
~2026-05-28T11:15Z +step:id=4,text=write-e2e-tests,atomic=true,deps=2|3
EOF
cat > .memplan/progress <<'EOF'
0/4 | not started
EOF
cat > .memplan/deps-closure.mem <<'EOF'
plan.mem:slice.mem
progress:slice.mem
EOF
evals.expected_output: Current step 1 is identified from progress. Step 1 is refined into 1.1–1.K sub-steps. Progress denominator updated. Sub-steps are atomic and have appropriate dependencies.

assertions.text: Skill correctly identifies step 1 as the current step from progress
plan.mem contains sub-steps 1.1, 1.2, etc., all atomic=true
progress denominator reflects new leaf count

evals.description: Idempotency check: attempting to refine an already-refined step without force=true should halt gracefully.
evals.setup:
mkdir -p /tmp/eval-refine-2/.memplan && cd /tmp/eval-refine-2 && cat > .memplan/plan.mem <<'EOF'
title:data-migration
step-count:#3
status:in-progress
~2026-05-28T12:00Z +step:id=1,text=backup-database,atomic=true
~2026-05-28T12:05Z +step:id=2,text=run-migration-scripts,refined=true
~2026-05-28T12:06Z +step:id=2.1,text=validate-schema,atomic=true
~2026-05-28T12:07Z +step:id=2.2,text=migrate-data,atomic=true,deps=2.1
~2026-05-28T12:08Z +step:id=2.3,text=verify-data-integrity,atomic=true,deps=2.2
~2026-05-28T12:10Z +step:id=3,text=update-docs,atomic=true,deps=2
EOF
cat > .memplan/progress <<'EOF'
1/5 | step 1 complete
EOF
cat > .memplan/deps-closure.mem <<'EOF'
plan.mem:slice.mem
EOF
evals.expected_output: Skill halts with message: 'Step 2 already refined — use force=true to re-refine.' No files are written.

assertions.text: Skill detects refined=true on step 2 and halts without writing
No new sub-steps are appended to plan.mem

evals.description: Re-refining a step with force=true overwrites previous sub-steps. Validates that old sub-steps are replaced and progress is recalculated.
evals.setup:
mkdir -p /tmp/eval-refine-3/.memplan && cd /tmp/eval-refine-3 && cat > .memplan/plan.mem <<'EOF'
title:api-refactor
step-count:#3
status:in-progress
~2026-05-28T13:00Z +step:id=4,text=refactor-api,atomic=true
~2026-05-28T13:05Z +step:id=5,text=update-tests,refined=true
~2026-05-28T13:06Z +step:id=5.1,text=update-unit-tests,atomic=true
~2026-05-28T13:07Z +step:id=5.2,text=update-integration-tests,atomic=true
~2026-05-28T13:10Z +step:id=6,text=deploy,atomic=true,deps=5
EOF
cat > .memplan/progress <<'EOF'
1/4 | step 4 complete
EOF
cat > .memplan/deps-closure.mem <<'EOF'
plan.mem:slice.mem
EOF
evals.expected_output: Step 5 is re-refined. New sub-steps replace the old ones. Progress denominator is recalculated to reflect the new leaf count. Note: This eval assumes the CLI supports updating sub-steps; if not, this tests the re-refine logic only.

assertions.text: Skill proceeds despite refined=true because force=true was specified
New sub-steps are appended (may duplicate; compaction is a separate concern)
progress denominator reflects new leaf count

evals.description: Atomic step check: attempting to refine a step already marked atomic=true should halt gracefully with no refinement needed.
evals.setup:
mkdir -p /tmp/eval-refine-4/.memplan && cd /tmp/eval-refine-4 && cat > .memplan/plan.mem <<'EOF'
title:simple-task
step-count:#2
status:in-progress
~2026-05-28T14:00Z +step:id=7,text=run-linter,atomic=true
~2026-05-28T14:05Z +step:id=8,text=commit-changes,atomic=true,deps=7
EOF
cat > .memplan/progress <<'EOF'
0/2 | not started
EOF
cat > .memplan/deps-closure.mem <<'EOF'
plan.mem:slice.mem
EOF
evals.expected_output: Skill halts with message: 'Step 7 is already atomic — no refinement needed.' No files are written.

assertions.text: Skill detects atomic=true on step 7 and halts without writing
